reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is '/data/' + param where param = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). User-controlled input flows directly into Paths.get() without proper path traversal prevention. The regex validation (param.matches(pat)) does not reliably prevent path traversal attacks since the init parameter pattern may not block '../' sequences. Files.readAllBytes() executes with potentially malicious path constructed from user input.

evidence.note: Sink: Paths.get('/data/' + param) passes user-controlled param directly to file system API
